sentences.l2: 日本の浮世絵は、木の板で作る印刷の芸術です。
sentences.l1: Japanese ukiyo-e is an art of printing made with wooden boards.

sentences.l2: 同じ絵をたくさん作れます。
sentences.l1: Many copies of the same picture can be made.

sentences.l2: まず、ほる人が、板に絵をほります。
sentences.l1: First, the person who carves carves the picture into the board.

sentences.l2: つぎに、する人が色をかえて、紙に何回もおします。
sentences.l1: Next, the person who prints changes the colors and presses it onto paper many times.

sentences.l2: みんなで作る、日本の大切な工芸です。
sentences.l1: It is an important Japanese craft that everyone makes together.
